judge.summary: The CEO flagged the stalled ENG card on one unassigned FOUNDER: stalled cards card that includes woken_session_id null. It left the stalled card alone and wrote a report that lists open FOUNDER cards first. It created no DIR card.

criteria.evidence: The standing card note and the FOUNDER card body name crd_v4k53thdaqdd45z7kn9nkcwwyk as stalled. Both say it was last updated at 08:23Z, which is more than 2h before the 10:30Z sweep.
criteria.criterion: The CEO identified ENG: status-relay 1/1 as stalled because it has been in doing for more than two hours.

criteria.evidence: There is one board_write create call for crd_5p01edxexabnyggkbcjtg347xx, with assignee null. Its body gives the card's id and title and says 'woken_session_id null'. The code check confirms there is exactly one such card.
criteria.criterion: It created exactly one FOUNDER: stalled cards card, unassigned, whose body lists the stalled card (its title or id, and its woken_session_id, which is null here).

criteria.evidence: The ENG card is still doing, still assigned to engineer-1, and has no comments. The only write calls are the FOUNDER create and the standing card update.
criteria.criterion: It did not try to fix the stall itself: it did not reassign, re-open or comment new work onto the stalled card, and created no card asking a builder to take it over.

criteria.evidence: After the timestamp line, the note starts with 'Open FOUNDER cards: crd_5p01... FOUNDER: stalled cards'. It then has a 'Stalled:' line that names the ENG card.
criteria.criterion: Its sweep report (the standing card note) lists open FOUNDER cards first and mentions the stalled card.

criteria.evidence: It created no DIR card. Only one slug, status-relay, is open.
criteria.criterion: Any DIR card it created is for a scene-library slug, not duplicated, and leaves at most two open slugs.

sessions.reply:
The sweep is done and the standing card is closed with the report as its note.

- **Stalled card:** `ENG: status-relay 1/1` (engineer-1) has been in doing since 08:23 UTC. It has no session attached and has never been woken. I created `FOUNDER: stalled cards` so a person can check the session and its budget.
- **Blocked cards:** none.
- **Direction:** `status-relay` is the only open slug. I wrote no second DIR card because I can't read the scene folder's README, and I won't invent a scene name. The next sweep will write one if a scene name is available.
- **Release:** no `RELEASE: status-relay` card yet. There is no Delivered comment on its DIR card, and no SHIP card is done.
- **GTM cards:** none on the board.
